claim: A CloudHSM cluster is a collection of HSMs that CloudHSM keeps in sync. If the keys on the HSMs fall out of synchronization, CloudHSM automatically resynchronizes them; this automatic resynchronization applies only to keys, not to users and policies.

evidence.quote: A cluster is a collection of individual HSMs that AWS CloudHSM keeps in sync. When you perform a task or operation on one HSM in a cluster, the other HSMs in that cluster are automatically kept up to date.
If the keys on HSMs in a cluster fall out of synchronization, AWS CloudHSM automatically resynchronizes them.
This automatic resynchronization applies only to keys. Users and policies (such as mTLS settings) are not automatically resynchronized.
